The plate looks like a compostable round plate, probably about 18-20 cm across. In the image it is roughly 260 px wide. The meat pile takes up about 160 px by 200 px, but it is irregular, so it covers perhaps 20% of the plate area.

The pieces are about 2-2.5 cm thick, and there are about 4-5 of them. The footprint is roughly 100 cm², and at an average height of 2 cm that gives about 150 cm³ of meat. Allowing for gaps, I estimate about 120 cm³, which at roughly 1.05 g/cm³ comes to about 125 g.

The meat is seasoned, seared steak that is medium-rare. I'll use about 200 kcal per 100 g.
